content: The E2E transformer defined in this document shall be used as a transformer if 1. the attribute protocol of the TransformationTechnology is set to E2E 2. and the attribute version of the TransformationTechnology is set to 1.0.0 3. and the attribute transformerClass of the TransformationTechnology is set to safety
